escalation_triggers: backend caching change on a ClickHouse-backed endpoint
reconcile_note: Single sonnet prep pass (confidence 72) + haiku grep backstop. Deep N=3 candidate reconcile consolidated by driver judgment: the escalation is DESIGN-DECISION-driven (product calls only Dalton can make), not code-uncertainty-driven — the scope is a well-grounded 4-file change sourced from direct file reads, and the material questions BLOCK at the gate where blind candidates cannot help. Documented in journal.
synthesis: The 'Live Hits Pending Repossession' card (DashboardOverlay.vue, fed by the shared Pinia `dashboard` store's `recentHits`) only loads once on mount / manual date-range switch — neither the admin Bird's Eye org map nor the driver Scout app refetches it in any poll loop. The ticket wants that list to self-refresh so newly-landed live hits appear without a manual browser refresh, on the admin/org-wide view (AC3), with the poll cadence reconciled against server caching so we don't add uncoalesced ClickHouse load (AC2). Both surfaces already run a chained-setTimeout ~10s poll loop (useBirdsEyePolling admin / useKitPositionPolling driver) refreshing sibling live data (positions, paths, stats); the natural fix is to fold a `dashboard.fetchRecentHits('today')` call into those loops. IMPORTANT correction: the ticket's '~3s cache' premise is false for normal paths — driver recentHits TTL is 90s (3s only under admin_impersonator), and the admin Bird's Eye recentHits endpoint has NO cache at all today.

scope.summary: Fold `dashboard.fetchRecentHits('today')` into the existing admin (and, pending Q1, driver) ~10s poll loop, gated exactly like the sibling `fetchStats('today')` calls already are; add `Cache::remember` to the currently-uncached admin `recentHits()` endpoint so the new poll doesn't hit ClickHouse unthrottled.

questions.q: Scope: should auto-refresh also apply to the DRIVER PWA surface (the store/component are shared, so it's nearly free to add), or stay admin-only per the ticket title 'Scout Admin Map'? (PWA battery/data cost on the driver side.)
questions.answer: BOTH surfaces — add fetchRecentHits to the driver poll loop (useKitPositionPolling) AND the admin poll loop (useBirdsEyePolling).

questions.q: Interval/staleness: what poll interval should recentHits use, and does the driver-side 90s cache TTL need to shrink to make polling meaningful — or is up to ~90s eventual-consistency acceptable for a 'live' feed? (The ticket's '~3s cache' premise is factually wrong; the reconciliation number is a real product/cost call.)
questions.answer: COMBINE with the existing kit-position/stats polling — fold fetchRecentHits('today') into the SAME ~10s poll tick as fetchStats (no new timer), on both loops. Reconcile by caching the admin recentHits endpoint at a TTL matched to the poll cadence (~10s) so repeated polls/multiple tabs coalesce to at most one ClickHouse query per org per interval. No change to the driver 90s TTL is needed since the driver poll rides the same tick and the 'today' window tolerates ~10-20s staleness.

questions.q: Adjacent bug: the driver-only useKitPositionPolling currently mounts unconditionally in admin Bird's Eye mode (MapShell v-if lacks a !adminMode guard), double-firing fetchStats('today') and hitting nonexistent admin kit-position/live-path routes (200 text/html) — likely sibling DEV-2184. Fix it here (it bears directly on 'don't hammer the backend'), or leave it to DEV-2184?
questions.answer: FIX HERE — add a !mapStore.adminMode guard to MapShell's LiveTracking mount so useKitPositionPolling runs only on the driver. This also cleanly separates the two loops so 'both surfaces' gives each surface exactly one fetchRecentHits (admin via useBirdsEyePolling, driver via useKitPositionPolling).

Poll (client interval). No HitCreated/broadcast event exists; admin Bird's Eye has no Echo/Sanctum connection (session-authed only, per birdseye.js); both sibling live-data composables already use chained-setTimeout polling. Push would require new backend broadcast infra — out of proportion.

questions.q: Should the admin Bird's Eye recentHits() endpoint gain server-side caching in this ticket?
questions.answer: Yes — it currently has none while siblings hits()/stats() on the same controller cache; a poll without a cache directly contradicts AC2.
